interactive_features.name: Player Influx rate mapping
interactive_features.description: The Player Influx slider (id slPop, min 0 max 5) selects an INTENSITY LEVEL, not a literal per-tick count. Map the slider index to a real players-per-tick growth rate: index 0..5 -> [0, 1, 5, 15, 40, 100]. BUG TO FIX: the original code did players += parseInt(slPop.value), using the raw slider index (0-5) as the per-tick rate, so even the top 'Flood/Zerg Rush' setting only added ~5 players per tick — far too weak to visibly move the economy. Apply the mapped rate so the top setting clearly floods the market and the Active Players figure climbs fast.

interactive_features.name: Players series own axis
interactive_features.description: The Chart.js line chart plots three series over time: Bread Price, Total Gold, and Players. BUG TO FIX: the Players dataset was bound to yAxisID 'yGold' — the gold axis, scaled to tens of thousands — so the Players line (range roughly 50-500) renders flat on the baseline and looks like it stays at 0. Give the Players dataset its OWN y axis, scaled to player counts, so the Players line rises visibly as population grows. Keep Bread Price on its own left axis and Total Gold on the gold axis.
